## Development and External Validation of an EHR-Derived Model for 30-Day Periprocedural Ischemic Stroke
**Shu L**, Furie KL, Garcia Guarniz AL, de Havenon A, Khan F, … Wu M, Zheng HB, Yaghi S. *Journal of the American Heart Association*. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42261949/) · [Calculator](https://liqi-shu.github.io/peri-procedural-stroke-calc/) · [Source code](https://github.com/liqi-shu/peri-procedural-stroke-calc)

::: {.pub-finding}
Developed and validated across approximately 445,000 procedures, with an external-validation AUC of 0.86.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.pub-entry}

::: {.pub-copy}
## Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction in Stroke
Zhong Z, Porto CM, Hong D, … **Shu L**, Baird G, Jayaraman M, Yaghi S, Jiao Z, Wolman DN. *American Journal of Neuroradiology*. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41720514/)

::: {.pub-finding}
Across 2,416 thrombectomy reports, the highest-performing open-source model achieved 94.8% overall extraction accuracy.
:::

## Intravenous Thrombolysis in Cervical Artery Dissection–Related Stroke
**Shu L**, **Lee E**, Field TS, Guo X, Henninger N, Keser Z, … Yaghi S. *Journal of the American Heart Association*. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39968775/)

::: {.pub-finding}
